Hand-picked images in assets/brand/ are crops of the site's own homepage/menu imagery: hero = the Outerwear menu image (AW26 shoot; the homepage's Wax x Deveaux slide is a pale paper collage with the logo baked in, which the white app menu can't sit on), the Overshirts category tile, the Colour Spotlight: Brown banner, the Wax x Deveaux desktop banner and the Camden Town Brewery journal banner. Logos are the site's header SVG (wax / london).

Orders are dispatched Monday to Friday; weekend orders go out the next working day.

returns.summary: Returns and exchanges are accepted within 30 calendar days of delivery. UK returns start in our returns portal with your order number and email. Underwear is non-returnable; fragrances and candles must be returned sealed.

_rewards: Wax London has no loyalty programme. The template's Account rewards card is kept as an illustrative app concept (as the yelir reference build) and its fine print says so; it never claims a real scheme.
_discount: The site's sign-up offers 10% off your first full-price purchase (code emailed). The app pop-up mirrors 10% with the placeholder code APP10.

copy.about: Founded in 2015, Wax is a London-based brand born out of a desire to make clothes with character. We source unique fabrics, weaves, textures, patterns and prints from sustainable mills and partners, blending British heritage, Mediterranean sensibility and Indian craftsmanship through a London-centric lens.

help.sum:
Delivery
Orders are dispatched Monday to Friday. Orders placed on Saturday or Sunday will be processed on the next working day.
The below times are indicative and will vary based on specific end location details.
Standard (Royal Mail) - Free With Orders Above £125 (£5.00 Otherwise)
Sent via Royal Mail on a 2-3 working days service.
If for some reason you're not home when Royal Mail call, they will attempt redelivery once and will leave you a contact card to reschedule a delivery.
Next Day (Royal Mail) - £9.50
Sent on a next working day service (order before 6PM UK time).
If for some reason you're not home when delivery is attempted, they will attempt redelivery once, and will leave you a contact card to reschedule a delivery.
Europe
Standard delivery is expected within 4-10 working days - Free (above €150)
Express delivery is expected within 2-3 days working days - €25 (above €150), €40 (below €150)

Returns & Exchanges: items you want to return for a refund or an exchange will be accepted within 30 calendar days of delivery (Worldwide).
UK returns and exchanges: start in our returns portal with your order number and the email address used to place the order.
Underwear is non returnable. Fragrances & Candles must be returned in the original sealed packaging.
